userStories.title: Make renderStateFile/clearActive preserve the loop phase
userStories.description: As the sidecar owner of cam-loop.local.md, I need the state-file writers to stop collapsing phase to idle so that phase:idle vs phase:implementing is a trustworthy parked/live discriminator (Defect 3 root, precondition for re-arm).
acceptanceCriteria: renderStateFile is read-modify-write: an absent phase argument preserves the current file's phase; an explicit phase wins; a nonexistent file defaults to idle. A unit test asserts that rendering with absent phase over an existing phase:implementing state re-emits phase:implementing (not idle). [oracle: bun test]
clearActive no longer collapses phase to idle: after clearActive runs over a phase:implementing file, the file still carries phase:implementing. [oracle: bun test]

The CAM-191 phase:shipping reorder workaround is retired (its code/comment is removed) and a test confirms phase:shipping still survives an orchestrator teardown, i.e. the ship-phase survival CAM-191 secured is not regressed. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/next.ts (renderStateFile ~line 80-130, effectivePhase derivation at 109-111 is the phase-drop when active:false + no phase), src/commands/sidecar.ts (makeClearActive ~305-395 renders with active:false and no phase). Cross-ref CAM-191 (shipped) only reordered phase:shipping to survive teardown and deliberately left this phase-drop in place; retiring the workaround is in scope. This is the root of the 3 coupled defects: phase:idle-as-parked is only trustworthy after this fix (gotcha in issue spec).

userStories.title: Re-arm implementing at sidecar boot and idle-tick for in-flight PRDs
userStories.description: As an operator whose cam run restarted mid-cycle, I need the sidecar to auto-resume an in-flight PRD instead of wedging idle so that no operator `cam next` is required to recover (Defect 1).
acceptanceCriteria: At sidecar boot AND at the idle-tick, when prd.json is in-flight (>=1 non-operator story with passes:false) AND phase==implementing AND the loop is not already active, the sidecar re-arms implementing, gated on the SAME drain preconditions as meta-loop dispatch (no blocked terminal, no pending merge-watch, no plan/ship phase in progress). [oracle: bun test]
phase:idle is the parked discriminator and never auto-resumes: an in-flight PRD with phase:idle stays parked. [oracle: bun test]
On the idle-tick, re-arm is checked BEFORE meta-loop dispatch so a resumable in-flight PRD is not shadowed by a new backlog dispatch. [oracle: bun test]
Re-arm is refused (no resume) when any drain precondition fails. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (phase preservation) AND US-002 (file survives) so phase==implementing is trustworthy. Files: src/commands/sidecar.ts (boot path ~runSidecar; makeReadLoopPhase 307-319, makeHasPendingStories 410+, drain preconditions via evaluateDrainPreconditions), src/supervisor/loop.ts (idle-tick outer loop, `active !== true` branch ~1876-1922, meta-loop observe hook 1887-1897). Re-use existing hasPendingStories + readPhase + preconditionFn seams rather than new readers. Gotcha (issue): on the idle-tick re-arm must run before dispatchOrDrain. Do NOT auto-resume phase:idle.
